dedupe_keys.name: masaryk encrypted web traffic event logs and packet traces

description: This collection pairs encrypted network-packet traces with server event logs from Masaryk University in the Czech Republic. The researchers monitored eight web servers hosting more than eight hundred websites during 30 July–6 August 2021, to compare host-side events with encrypted traffic. The article describes TLS 1.2 packet captures with microsecond timestamps and IIS event logs in JSON Lines format. Science Data Bank publishes the named resource and associated anonymization and packet-to-flow support folders free under CC BY 4.0. The article’s Mendeley link points to a different survey; the matching Science Data Bank page and DOI establish the corrected access route. Coverage is limited to one campus and one week, with anonymized identifiers and encrypted content. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating event-to-flow relationships or traffic-monitoring assumptions in network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without a tested conversion. No packet file, event log or bundled utility was downloaded or executed.
name: Masaryk encrypted web traffic: event logs and packet traces
